run_inception_moments: run the script to calculate Inception moments and save mu and sigma to an NPZ file
run_inception_score: run the script to compute the Inception Score for a dataset split like train or val
run_stratified_moments: run the script with stratified moments to compute FID metrics for many, medium, and few-shot classes
run_inception_parallel: run the script with parallel GPU support to calculate Inception metrics across multiple GPUs
run_inception_coco: run the script on the COCO dataset to calculate Inception moments for validation or test splits
